image_description: A European fire salamander (Salamandra salamandra) is positioned on a bed of green moss and small twigs, partially sheltered beneath a dark, textured rock overhang. The amphibian displays the characteristic glossy black skin with vivid, irregular yellow blotches covering its back, head, and limbs. Its body is robust and cylindrical, held low to the ground in a walking posture. The head is broad with visible parotoid glands behind the eyes. Short, stout limbs support the body, and a laterally compressed tail extends behind it.
